The '''''Silver Star''''' was a [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 ''Rigger''-class light freighter]] produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Silver Star'' was captained by [[Saral Aenet]], and was attacked by a [[Pathfinder-class scout ship|''Pathfinder''-class scout ship]] carrying [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] hired by [[Erron Irbian]].<ref name="CotG" />

At this time, the ship contained the [[Holocron of Suljo Warde]] in a secret compartment in the ship's cockpit.<ref name="CotG" />
